author: Neal A. Maxwell
note: 1970 Deseret Book. Maxwell's earliest book — written as CES Commissioner, BEFORE his 1974 Assistant-to-the-Twelve calling. Aphoristic/reflective musings on LDS life. Title from D&C 58:28. Authority=30 (institutional LDS scholarship, not apostolic) because pre-GA. Interesting as biographical-historical artifact of early Maxwell voice.
